top_signals.title: House committee releases sweeping crypto tax bill ahead of Wednesday markup
top_signals.summary: Among its provisions is a $10 exception for certain fees paid in crypto, along with provisions covering stablecoins, mining, and staking.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she wants a crypto bill, but the Clarity Act just isn’t it
top_signals.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she remains determined to get a crypto bill signed into law — even if she doesn’t support the current Clarity Act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Standard Chartered sees Arbitrum at $10 by end-2030, up 70-fold
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered sees Arbitrum at $10 by 2030, projecting a roughly 70-fold increase as tokenization grows and TradFi firms move onchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix
top_signals.summary: Companies are helping universities develop courses, provide financial support and create pathways through which qualifying students can join them.
